title.narrative: Initiation Plan (IP) för Uppskalning av LoGIC

description.narrative:
Initiation Plan (IP)-projektet kommer att förbereda den nationella uppskalningen av det pågående Local Government Initiative on Climate Change (LoGIC)-projektet. Målet är att överbrygga gapet mellan slutförandet av det nuvarande LoGIC-projektet (LoGIC I) och utvecklingen, regeringens godkännande och lansering av LoGIC II, där en central del kommer att vara en föreslagen blandad finansieringsanläggning. IP-fasen är avsedd att möjliggöra en fullskalig utrullning av LoGIC från nuvarande 9 till 33 distrikt (en geografisk täckning av mer än 50 % av Bangladesh, som har 64 distrikt).
Syftet med IP-­fasen är att stödja Local Government Division (LGD) och External Relations Division (ERD) i finansministeriet att överta LoGIC­-modellen och skala upp till nationell nivå via en blandad finansiering facilitet med både lån och bidrag. Ett preliminärt projektförslag (PDPP) har godkänts av LGD med ett åtagande på 42 000 000 USD från egna medel för detta ändamål. Som nästa steg har ERD tagit ansvar för att förbereda den blandade finansieringsfaciliteten och engagera bilaterala och multilaterala finansiella institutioner.

The Initiation Plan (IP) Project will prepare the national scale-­up of the Local Government Initiative on Climate Change (LoGIC) project. It aims to bridge the gap between the completion of the current LoGIC project (LoGIC I) and the development, government approval and launch of LoGIC II, a central feature of which will be a proposed blended finance facility. The IP Phase is intended to enable a full­-scale roll-out of LoGIC from the current 9 to 33 Districts (a geographic coverage of more than 50% of Bangladesh, which has 64 Districts).
The purpose of the IP Phase is to support the Local Government Division (LGD) and External Relations Division (ERD) to transition the LoGIC model to a national scale-up via a blended finance facility using both loans and grants. A Preliminary Development Project Proposal (PDPP) has been approved by the LGD with a commitment of USD 42 000 000 from its own allocation for this purpose. As a next step, the ERD has taken responsibility for preparing the blended finance facility and engaging co-financing partners from among the bilateral and multilateral financial institutions.

The overall objective of LoGIC is: Improved and inclusive local level planning and a strengthened financing mechanism for community-based climate change adaptation solutions through local governments.
The purpose of the Initiation Plan (IP) Phase is to support the Local Government Division (LGD) of the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development & Cooperatives and the External Relations Division (ERD) of the Ministry of Finance to transition the LoGIC model to a national scale-up via an innovative financing approach and facility using both loans and grants.
The main outputs of the IP during the 12 months are:
1. Technical assistance to Local Government Divison (LGD) and External Relations Division (ERD) to mobilize concessional loans and grants from MDBs and development partners, develop key documents and financial proposals, and catalyze cross ministerial coordination for locally-led adaptation.
2. Strengthening of climate-resilient cooperatives and youth- and women-led green enterprises, linking to market systems through value chain development and engagement of the private sector.
3. Operationalization of tools like the Climate Vulnerability Index (CVI) and Local Adaptation Plan of Action (LAPA) across ministries.
4. Design of a blended financing mechanism to mobilize private sector investment for local climate adaptation and Nature-based Solution (NbS) investments, leveraging innovative financial instruments and strategic partnerships.
5. An enhanced performance-based climate resilience grant (PBCRG) system which enables incorporating climate adaptation and resilience considerations into national and local planning, budgeting and monitoring processes.
6. Climate risk insurance mechanisms and financial protection instruments developed and institutionalised into local adaptation frameworks to safeguard public and private investments while de-risking and attracting private finance.

tag.narrative: 13.1 - Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries.
13.1 - Stärka motståndskraften mot och förmågan till anpassning till klimatrelaterade faror och naturkatastrofer i alla länder.
13.2 - Integrate climate change measures into national policies, strategies and planning.
13.2 - Integrera klimatåtgärder i politik, strategier och planering på nationell nivå.

13.b - Främja mekanismer för att höja förmågan till effektiv klimatrelaterad planering och förvaltning i de minst utvecklade länderna, med särskilt fokus på kvinnor, ungdomar samt lokala och marginaliserade samhällen.

13.b - Promote mechanisms for raising capacity for effective climate change-related planning and management in least developed countries and small island developing States, including focusing on women, youth and local and marginalized communities.
